name: Tomas Tobé - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out what it thinks the European Democracy Shield should do. It asks for a new EU centre to fight foreign interference and disinformation, with a clear legal basis, its own budget and staff, and oversight by Parliament. It wants existing EU laws on platforms, media and artificial intelligence fully enforced, better protection for elections and critical infrastructure, more support for independent media and civil society, and stronger sanctions. The report is a set of recommendations, not a law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only recommends; the Commission must propose laws and budgets.
- **Who it affects:** EU institutions, national governments, online platforms, media, civil society and voters.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to act on the proposals, including a legal act for the centre.
